notes: Corrected: the accepted alignment gave t014 'with' to s008 בְּ. That preposition stands on מַלְאָכָיו, which the ASV writes bare ('his angels he chargeth'), while the 'with' stands before the bare accusative תָּהֳלָה. It is therefore the preposition the English verb needs to reach its own object (rule 44) and belongs to יָשִׂים's unit, leaving s008 unrepresented under rule 40.
'no' goes to לֹא rather than to the noun: the ASV has turned the clause's negation into the complement's determiner (rule 15).
s006 heads on the complement 'trust', not on the light verb 'putteth' (rule 44).
